_meta.purpose: Inventory of user-visible strings to move into Languages/*.json (I18N-PLAN L04-L07). One entry per source occurrence; entries that share a key are the same catalog string used at several call sites.

conventions.key: lowercase-first dotted segments, camelCase inside a segment; plurals as .one/.other (vi uses plural:none, so only .other is read, but both forms are listed with the same vi text).
conventions.vi: Current source text verbatim with interpolation holes replaced by {placeholder}. If the current UI text is English, vi = that English text.
conventions.placeholders: Map of placeholder name -> C# expression that feeds it today. LocTemplate has no format specifiers, so numbers/dates/sizes must be pre-formatted by the caller exactly as today (format noted in the expression).
conventions.tests: Test files (file:line) that assert this exact text or a substring of it; they must keep passing with Localizer pinned to vi (L02).
